description: List the latest videos on one YouTube channel, given its @handle or URL (for example "@OpenAI" or https://www.youtube.com/@OpenAI). Returns up to 20 recent uploads with title, upload date, view count, duration and URL. Use it to audit a creator or competitor channel. To search all of YouTube by keyword use youtube_search.

maxRows.description: How many rows to return (1-20, default 20). The free ChatGPT app is capped at 20.
